item.title: Version 2.16.2
item.description:
What's New in Stash 2.16.2

  • Industry standard 1-click in-place background auto-updates via Sparkle 2.
  • Ed25519 cryptographic update signing and verification.
  • Screen corner responsiveness and dynamic display tracking improvements.
  • Menu bar icon and native macOS visual polish.

item.title: Version 2.9.7
item.description:
What's New in Stash 2.9.7

  • Stash Shelf performance and in-memory icon caching for locked 120 FPS interactions.
  • Direct URL drag providers eliminating main thread copy blocking.
  • Refined 44pt left edge handle hit zone with single-click opening.
  • Bidirectional shake-to-summon gesture recognition.

item.title: Version 2.3.2
item.description:
What's New in Stash 2.3.2

  • Ultra-smooth keyboard backlight scrubbing in the menu bar control popover.
  • Isolated slider views eliminating frame drops and jitter during dragging.
  • Automatic hardware backlight and master volume synchronization on appear.
  • One-click keyboard backlight toggle button on the menu bar keyboard icon.

item.title: Version 2.3.1
item.description:
What's New in Stash 2.3.1

  • Integrated satellite micro-buttons (Reset and Skip) inside Pomodoro Corner Dial.
  • Round progression indicators with clean circular pips inside the center badge.
  • Edge Slider completely hidden when idle, smoothly gliding into view on hover.
  • Fixed gesture touch conflict on CenterActionBadge preventing accidental time jumps.
